scripts.zip: ! grep -rl REPLACE_ME src && cd src && zip -qr ../tabdial.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.zip:firefox: ! grep -rl REPLACE_ME src && rm -rf build/firefox && mkdir -p build && cp -R src build/firefox && node -e "const f='build/firefox/manifest.json',m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f));m.permissions=m.permissions.filter(p=>p!=='favicon').concat('identity');m.optional_permissions=m.optional_permissions.filter(p=>p!=='identity');m.background={scripts:[m.background.service_worker],type:m.background.type};delete m.externally_connectable;require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2))" && cd build/firefox && zip -qr ../../tabdial-firefox.zip . -x '.*'
